correctness.rationale: PASS. For a,b>0 and edge-line phi in (0,pi/2], W=a|cos theta|+b|cos(theta-phi)|. Direct integration independently agrees with mu=2(a+b)/pi, nu=(a²+b²)/2+(2ab/pi)[sin phi+(pi/2-phi)cos phi], and D²=a²+b²+2ab cos phi. Setting s=pi mu/2, X=s²-D² and Y=s²/2-nu gives T=Y/X=1/2-F(phi)/pi with F=(sin phi-phi cos phi)/(1-cos phi), F'=sin phi(phi-sin phi)/(1-cos phi)²>0. F runs from 0 to 1, so inversion uniquely recovers phi and ab, then sorted roots of t²-st+ab give unordered side lengths; T range [1/2-1/pi,1/2). On bounded nonflattening classes, all steps prior to roots are Lipschitz and sqrt discriminant gives uniform 1/2 Holder; perturbing equal sides (1,1)→(1+t,1-t) moves stats by O(t²) but lengths O(t), proving optimality at rhombi. Independently checked quadrature for multiple parameters. Degenerate phi=0 and sides=0 excluded; rectangle endpoint and rhombi included.
